scores.evidence: Newsprint, Ink, amber italic, Zodiak/Sentient/JetBrains Mono, 8/12/16 radii, Night band and the adopted 21st.dev set all match (desktop-fold.png, d-04-s3.png, d-13-BAND738.png). Miss: the hero chart is almost all below the fold, so the brief's 'drawing rising below' hero is not read at 1440x900.

Hero 1-2-3 is clear (headline, deck, Start reading under it, Ink as the only outlier). Weak: the hero drawing, the real primary visual, shows about 130px at the fold with the spike cut off (desktop-fold.png). In the band the left column has a 330px empty hole between the paragraph and the 12:17 note, and the narration notes sit bottom-left (d-13-BAND738.png).

Two serifs plus mono for data, tight tracking, 400 display weight, left-aligned body, sentence case, no uppercase labels. Band headline wraps with an orphan ('Your phone on 8 / October.') at 64px in a 680px column (d-12-BAND600.png).

Section rhythm and card gaps are consistent (d-04-s3.png). The band's mb-[30vh] gaps leave dead bands, and the two-tone band headline has no gap between its tones (d-12-BAND600.png). The hero-to-statement gap was not captured.

Recognisable identity: newsprint, ink and one amber signal with a near-black band; Held green and red used only as meaning; light-mode shadows are soft. The cream-to-dark drop works but the sticky header sits over the cut, and amber reads as small accents rather than one recalled colour moment.

Eight restyled 21st.dev pieces (grid, notification stack, highlighter, citations, TOC rail, count up, language switch, text reveal); strategy cards, dial and Isolation Forest are interactive (d-04-s3.png, sheet-d.png). Focus, hover and pressed states were not captured, so they are not credited.

No text gradients, glows, pills or uppercase tracking; copy is plain. Small tells: the evidence chip repeats on all 5 strategy cards and the mono 'Pattern measured in data' line adds a third label voice (d-04-s3.png).

The pinned, scrubbed phone band is a real signature moment and scroll devices differ by section (sheet-d.png). Held back: the hero drawing and its notification sit below the fold so the sequence plays unseen; reduced-motion fold is intact (desktop-fold-reduced.png).

390px sheet: no horizontal scroll, headline fits, hero chart rises under the actions, band becomes a docked mini phone with notes below (sheet-m.png). The docked phone starts as an empty grey box with only the time, and the band headline wraps to 3 lines.

Tell-someone sentence names an experience; colour identity holds at thumbnail size; section treatments differ (hero, Paper abstract card, Pulp specimen grid, Night band, pull quote). Round's two-tone statement exists in code (PaperPage.tsx:99) but no capture shows it, and the Auxia two-tone band headline reads as one heavy block.

clean.md: build and sitecheck pass, all text pairs at least 4.5:1, body at least 7:1, one h1, skip link present. Not credited: visible focus rings, keyboard use of the span role=button citations, the live site.

mechanism_verdicts.round_serif_hero_with_drawing_rising: Half landed. The centred Zodiak headline with amber italic 'machine-speed' is strong and the card overlap is clever, but the 1440x900 fold shows only the top 130px of the chart, so the drawing does not rise into view. Mobile (sheet-m.png) lands better.
mechanism_verdicts.round_two_tone_statement: Written (PaperPage.tsx:99, Ink then Ash, 30ch measure) but absent from every screenshot, so unverified. At 44px in a 30ch column the 55-word paragraph runs about 9 lines, heavy for a statement.
mechanism_verdicts.auxia_cream_to_dark_band: Landed. The cut from cream to Night desk is the clearest moment on the page and the phone then holds it. Weakness: the empty left column while the phone scrubs.
mechanism_verdicts.auxia_two_tone_headline: Partly landed. Ink over grey reads, but 'Your phone on 8 / October.' orphans and the tones touch with no gap, so it reads as one block.
